OFFENSE: Spells Known (FC CL 6th [8th for enfeebling]; concentration +10 [+12 for enfeebling])
At will (DC 14) - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic
1st (DC 15) - Blind, Charm, Mage Armor, Sleep, Wind Armor
2nd (DC 16) - Darkness, Grace, Poison, Silence, Wall Climb
STATISTICS: Str 10, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 18, Wis 14, Cha 10
Feat Combat Casting, Dodge, Improved Initiative
Skill Acrobatics +11, Bluff +8, Diplomacy +8, Escape Artist +11, Knowledge (Geography, Local, & Nature) +12, Perception +10, Sense Motive +10, Use Magic Device +8
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Enfeebling Arts (ex) All enfeebling spells' effects are increased by a +2 penalty of the appropriate type. All enfeebling spells' durations are increased by 2. All enfeebling spells' caster level are increased by 2. The caster level checks made to overcome a creature's spell resistance is increased by 2 for enfeebling spells.

Telekinetic (su) As a standard action, the cait sith may touch up to five items weighing up to 5 lbs., which begin to levitate in its space for the next 5 rounds. Immediately, and once per round as a standard action thereafter, it can launch one item at a target of its choice. The ranged attack is made as if you had thrown the item unless it's ammunition for a weapon, in which case the attack is made as if fired from a heavy crossbow (if a bolt), a halfling sling staff (if a sling bullet), a blowgun (if a blowgun dart), a composite longbow with a +2 Strength rating (if an arrow), an atlatl (if an atlatl dart), or a pistol (if a firearm bullet). A firearm pellet launched by the spell functions as a shuriken. When you launch ammunition with this spell, you don't take a penalty on your attack rolls for lacking proficiency with the ammunition's weapon; you do, however, take the usual -4 penalty for throwing an improvised weapon if you launch an item not intended to be used as a weapon. The attack roll uses your caster level in place of your base attack bonus and your Intelligence or Charisma modifier (whichever is higher) in place of your Dexterity modifier. Range increment and proficiency penalties apply as normal. The attack has an effective Strength bonus, if applicable, equal to the higher of your Intelligence and Charisma modifiers. The spell is discharged when all touched items have been launched. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 19).

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
